system.notes: SP 16 soft armor, EV +2, made entirely of circuit-embedded Kevlar; an integral hood and breathing mask cover the face. +3 to noise-related Stealth rolls, 90% invisible to radar, optics (low-lite, anti-dazzle, targeting scope, Times Square Plus). Same game effects as the Militech M96 Ghostsuit and the Gibson Sneak Suit: -4 to visual and infrared Awareness checks to spot, a further -1 per ten meters (Chromebook 2 p.27-28). Filtered environment, 95% immune to airborne gases and agents; a 4-hour rebreather can be fitted to the utility backpack. Two holsters included; scabbards for knives and short swords 1,000eb each.
